description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer class in the OpenClawKit project. It verifies the correctness of the watchdog timeout calculation based on different input texts and languages.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizerTests
classes.description: Unit test class for TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer to validate timeout behaviors.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutDefaultsToLatinProfile
methods.description: Tests that the default watchdog timeout is 24 seconds when no language is specified.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesKoreanProfile
methods.description: Tests that the watchdog timeout is 75 seconds for Korean text.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesChineseProfile
methods.description: Tests that the watchdog timeout is 84 seconds for Chinese text.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesJapaneseProfile
methods.description: Tests that the watchdog timeout is 60 seconds for Japanese text.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutClampsVeryLongUtterances
methods.description: Tests that very long text inputs are clamped to a maximum timeout of 900 seconds.
